title: Split filter resolver and preset support utilities
description: Refactor includes/Support/FilterResolver.php and includes/Support/FilterPresets.php into bounded parsing, matching, persistence, and normalization modules.
objective: Make filter data contracts easier to verify before adding deeper field-source, preset, or dynamic tag behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Escaping and sanitization contracts remain equivalent.
Each support module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.
risks: Subtle matching behavior can regress without characterization checks.
Preset defaults can drift if storage helpers are split poorly.
Dynamic field-source behavior can break if resolver assumptions change.
